the nematode C. elegans has the capacity for a remarkable degree of plasticity in its lifespan, and that this plasticity is due to the ability of the worm to alter the expression of genes involved in stress resistance, metabolism, and reproduction.
the nematode C. elegans is an excellent invertebrate model system for aging research.
